podcast.body: Although credited to Wham! in America, this song was essentially a George Michael solo single globally. It has gained stature since his untimely passing in 2016, noted for its iconic sax riff, indelible melody, and soulful vocal. The song crossed over to Billboard's R&B chart, cracking the Top 10. "That sacks riff is iconic. The melody is indelible, and the vocal by George Michael is among his most soulful."
